title: Optimized Distortion in Linear Social Choice
reasoning: The paper is a technical study in social choice theory focused on the 'distortion' metric for linear utility functions. While it uses Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) and 'value alignment' as primary motivations and utilizes an abortion opinion survey dataset for empirical evaluation, the core research objective is the mathematical and algorithmic optimization of utilitarian social welfare (modeled as inner products of vectors). It does not evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, specific moral reasoning, or ethical frameworks in the sense of analyzing content or beliefs.
